      public ZenMatrix(String secretKey, String hashIV, boolean fullSymmetric, KeyHash keyHash)
      initializes a ZenMatrix with secret user key string and hash iv
      Parameters:
      secretKey - user's secret key
      hashIV - private key hash iv string
      fullSymmetric - fullSymmetric means that zen matrix is it's inverse element and decrypts back to plain text, when encrypting twice or ²
      keyHash - KeyHash is used, when hash iv is null or empty to get new hash iv from user key

    • genBuildWithBytes

      protected void genBuildWithBytes(byte[] keyBytes, boolean fullSymmetric)
      Generates / builds a ZenMatrix with key bytes
      Parameters:
      keyBytes - users keybytes created by users key and key hash iv must have at least 4 bytes and will be truncated after 16 bytes only the first 16 bytes will be taken from keyBytes for ZenMatrix
      fullSymmetric - fullSymmetric means that zen matrix is it's inverse element and decrypts back to plain text, when encrypting twice or ²

    • processBytes

      protected byte[] processBytes(byte[] inBytes, int offSet, int len)
      ProcessBytes processes bytes for encryption or decryption depending on forEncryption processes the next len=16 bytes to encrypt, starting at offSet or processes the next len=16 bytes to decrypt, starting at offSet
      Parameters:
      inBytes - bytes array to encrypt
      offSet - starting offSet
      len - of byte block (default 16)
      Returns:
      byte[len] (default: 16) segment of encrypted bytes

    • padBuffer

      public byte[] padBuffer(byte[] inBytes, boolean useRandom)
      in case of encryption, pads 0 or random buffer at end of inBytes, so that inBytes % BLOCK_SIZE == 0 in case of decryption, trims remaining padding buffer from inBytes encryption or decryption are triggered via forEncryption
      Parameters:
      inBytes - input bytes to pad
      useRandom - >use random padding
      Returns:
      padded or unpadded out bytes
